description_en: Queries check item information for a specified risk item and a specified server
description_zh: 查询指定风险项和指定服务器下的检查项信息
name: DescribeCheckWarnings

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the server on which the baseline check is performed.

To query check item information for a specified risk item and a specified server, you must provide the ID of the server on which the baseline check is performed. You can call the [DescribeWarningMachines](~~DescribeWarningMachines~~) operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
执行基线检查的服务器的ID。

查询指定风险项和指定服务器下的检查项信息，需要提供执行基线检查的服务器的ID，该ID可调用[DescribeWarningMachines](~~DescribeWarningMachines~~)接口获取
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The risk item ID. This parameter is required.

To query check item information for a specified risk item and a specified server, you must provide the risk item ID. You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
风险项ID。该参数为必填参数。

查询指定风险项和指定服务器下的检查项信息，需要提供风险项ID，该ID可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~)接口获取
parameters.name: risk_id

parameters.help_en: The number of check items to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 check items are displayed on each page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的检查项信息的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条检查项信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The ID of the check item
parameters.name: check_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the check item. Valid values:

hc.check.type.identity_auth: identity authentication
hc.check.type.access_control: access control
hc.check.type.network_service: network and service
hc.check.type.service_conf: service configuration
hc.check.type.file_rights: file permission
hc.check.type.security_audit: security audit
hc.check.type.attack_defense: intrusion prevention
hc.check.type.others: others
parameters.help_zh:
检查项类型。取值：

hc.check.type.identity_auth：身份鉴别
hc.check.type.access_control：访问控制
hc.check.type.network_service：网络及服务
hc.check.type.service_conf：服务配置
hc.check.type.file_rights：文件权限
hc.check.type.security_audit：安全审计
hc.check.type.attack_defense：入侵防范
hc.check.type.others：其他
parameters.name: check_type

parameters.help_en:
The risk detection status. Valid values:

1: failed
2: verifying
3: passed
5: expired
6: ignored
parameters.help_zh:
风险检测状态。取值：

1：未通过
2：验证中
3：已通过
5：已失效
6：已忽略
parameters.name: risk_status

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

CheckWarnings.description_en: The details of the check items returned
CheckWarnings.description_zh: 查询到的检查项信息的详情

items.description_en: The details of a check item

CheckId.description_en: The ID of the check item

CheckWarningId.description_en: The alert data ID of the baseline check

ExecErrorMessage.description_en: The error message during the alert data check
ExecErrorMessage.description_zh: 告警数据检查中的错误信息

FixStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the fix is supported. Valid values:

0: not supported
1: supported
FixStatus.description_zh:
是否支持修复。取值：

0：不支持
1：支持

Item.description_en: The name of the check item

LastHandleTime.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent handling of the check item risk on the server. Unit: milliseconds
LastHandleTime.description_zh: 该机器的检查项风险的最新处理的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Level.description_en:
The risk level of the baseline check risk item. Valid values:

high: high
medium: medium
low: low
Level.description_zh:
基线检查风险项的危险等级。取值：

high：高危
medium：中危
low：低危

Status.description_en:
The status of the check item. Valid values:

1: The baseline check failed.

2: The baseline fix is being verified.

3: The baseline check passed.

5: The baseline check status has expired.

6: The baseline check item has been ignored
Status.description_zh:
检查项的状态。取值：

1：基线检查未通过

2：基线修复验证中

3：基线检查已通过

5：基线检查状态已失效

6：基线检查项已忽略

Type.description_en: The type of the check item

Uuid.description_en: The ID of the server on which the baseline check is performed
Uuid.description_zh: 执行基线检查的服务器的ID

Count.description_en: The number of check items displayed on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页显示检查项信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of check items displayed on each page in a paged query. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 check items are displayed on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的检查项信息的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条检查项信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of check items returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的检查项信息的总数量
